opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories before application; must hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, specialist software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including school engagement, public engagement, and work with under-represented audiences. Open for applications throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members in Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories; PhD students actively undertaking a PhD in chemical sciences, or researchers in chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education; Partner Scientists must have been members for at least 180 days before the round.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake an activity supporting their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses, or organising scientific meetings (virtual or in-person).

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside); will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering additional costs of care they usually provide, up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside); will use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports disabled chemists and those with ongoing health conditions with costs of specific support (equipment, services, personal expenses) to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events, up to £1,200 per year.
